name: kitt
pronunciation_note: Spoken as the name 'Kit' /kɪt/. 'Kit' is the same sound, so it is a positive spelling, not a negative. 'Kid' differs by final voicing and stays a hard negative. Same-sound spellings found by an espeak-ng IPA audit (2026-11-04) moved from confusables to accept_stems: Kid. German 'Kid' is devoiced to 'Kit' (same sound, removed from German confusables); English 'kid' keeps its voiced d and stays an English look-alike, so 'kid' is not an accept stem.
